{{Quote|In the final years of the reign of Ajunta Pall, five Dark Lords explored the machine&mdash;the Wraith Box. One burned in purple flame, another vanished from sight. Two brothers slew each other&mdash;and only one Sith returned to Korriban.|An excerpt from the chronicles|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Unintended Consequences|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Chronicles of Lord Skaysh''' was a series of obscure [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] texts written by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Skaysh]]. One of the topic covered by the chronicles was the legend of the [[Wraith Box]], a strange device from the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Ajunta Pall]].<ref name="TOR" />
